source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.note: Kit table row reads 'Sevilla Fundación 1890* Charity' with the footnote that it was announced as shirt sponsor for the start of the season rather than the whole season. The club announcement is at https://sevillafc.es/es/actualidad/noticias/camiseta-sevilla-fc-fundacion-1890 (2026-08-14).
source.quote: A day before their opening match, Sevilla announced their charity Fundación 1890 as shirt sponsor.
